name: style-souvenir
description: Souvenir style: a place told through its painted emblems, in the manner of tattoo flash, cigar-box and fruit-crate labels and holiday postcards — opaque paint modelled with light (pieces with a dark contour and airbrushed shade, still lifes in brush strokes with no line), packed with small true things (coins, relics, labels, creatures) on a painted ground, lettering on ribbons — as things floating loose at their own depths that a camera dives through down its axis, ever faster and rolling as it goes (depth of field, an open-shutter smear, a mist filter, lifted blacks). Use it for emblems, allegories of a place, its history or its culture, «kitsch», painted labels, studio idents, an «infinite zoom» through paintings, anything «packed with detail», or when working with styles/souvenir/.
